breaking.change: All source starts in a tick now share ascending entity slot-index order, ignoring generation, before voice allocation and voice-cap selection. New AudioSources, AudioEvent voices, retriggers and sound replacements no longer depend on archetype/query order or on whether a source was already playing. This changes SoundStarted order, voice ids, audio stream hashes and tied fresh-source cap selection where the old code-path order differed.
breaking.fix: Consume SoundStarted in its documented slot-index order, not author call order or new-before-retrigger order. Removing and reinserting AudioSource on the same entity does not change its ordering key. startAt still controls sample-accurate timing; this does not impose chronological event order within the tick.
